_comment: Default keyboard shortcuts for the unified control web (see web/app.js). 'switch' actions reference policies BY NAME, not by index — names come from ControlService.status() at runtime, so this file survives whatever --policy set swap_experiment.py was started with (an unknown name shows as unbound, not an error). 'move' actions are HELD, not tapped — WASD-style: press and hold to ramp velocity up (~10% of the trained range per tick), release to FREEZE at whatever value was reached (cruise, not brake — see app.js's rampTick()). 'axis' is 'vx' (forward/back), 'vy' (strafe left/right), or 'yaw' (turn); 'sign' is +1 or -1 and picks which end of that axis's trained range (command_ranges from /config) the key ramps toward. Yaw can also be driven by click-and-drag mouse look (see the Mouse look pad in the panel) — both work together. Edit this file directly to change v1 defaults; there is no in-page rebind UI yet.
